|lore=Luke Skywalker. Son of Anakin. Seeker of Yoda. Levitator of rocks. Ignorer of advice. Incapable of impossible. Reckless is he.
|game_text=Deploys only on Dagobah or Cloud City. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per game, during your deploy phase, a lightsaber may deploy on Luke (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.

* [[Bespin]] cloud sectors are ''not'' on Cloud City, so [[Son Of Skywalker]] may ''not'' deploy there or to the [[Bespin]] system.
* In brief: [[Son Of Skywalker]] may deploy to [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] sites, [[Dagobah (location){{!}}Dagobah]] clouds, and Cloud City sites.

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered Revised card, [[Son Of Skywalker (Revised)]] (December 1999).
